finding: On @makeyourmind.up the funnel numbers (profile visits, follows, saves) are carried by boosted posts; unboosted posts earn reach of about a thousand views a month and no follows. Read every account-level funnel number with the boosted posts taken out before calling it organic pull, and never compare it with an unboosted account.

evidence.result: 30 days to 19 Nov: 251 profile visits, 173 of them on the boosted 'Ten jobs' carousel; 2 boosted posts 9,226 views, 28 follows, 19 saves; 14 unboosted posts 934 views, 0 follows, 0 saves; boosts about $95 in the window, 0 new Substack subscribers in the boost week.

revisit_when: A month with no boost: read organic visits, follows and link taps on their own.
